summary: Use active voice rather than passive, and avoid future tense, because readers use the docs while they are working on the system.
questions: How do I rewrite a passive sentence in docs?

answer_card.title: Active voice
answer_card.answer_md: Write "Start Linuxconf by typing..." not "Linuxconf can be started by typing...". Write "The screen displays" not "The screen will display", because readers consult docs *while* using the system.
